SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AOUSC). GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Senior Business Analyst will work as part of the PACER Development team responsible for developing, operating, and supporting internal and external systems that allow for secure public access to court electronic records for the Judiciary.

The candidate will be responsible for supporting requirements development, analysis, and management, testing management, and testing for enterprise IT systems. The BA shall be skilled in refining business requirements, writing user stories, and developing functional mock-ups, as well as in preparing test plans, test cases, and coordinating user acceptance testing.

  • Support Testers to design test cases and test steps for thorough validation of work items
  • Maintain process flow in an easily accessible, hierarchical fashion so that an end-user can drill down a given process map at each level
